summary.text: Luca Welle is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Braxton Mitchell.
A river guide and substitute teacher, he named cost of living and public lands as key campaign messages in a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Luca Welle earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Montana in 2025 and has worked as a substitute teacher.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is 23, was born in the Flathead and has lived there except while attending the University of Montana, and works as a river guide and substitute teacher.

He listed volunteer work with the Citizen Science Program in Glacier National Park, service on the Montana Fish, Wildlife & Parks Future Fisheries Citizen Review Panel, and advocacy with Citizens' Climate Lobby and the UM Climate Response Club.
Welle's survey responses emphasized reducing the cost of living through fairer property taxes, housing and expanded Medicaid, and keeping public lands in public hands.
